summary: ph-common postinstall and import-time beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP
details: ph-common 3.0.0 is a stub package whose only behavior is a reconnaissance beacon. package.json declares a postinstall step that runs beacon.cjs, and the main entry (index.js) also fires the beacon at require() time via `require('./beacon.cjs').fire()`. beacon.cjs collects hostname, install path, process.cwd(), and process.version and POSTs them over plain HTTP to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. index.js exports a Proxy returning no-op functions for any property access, so the package provides no real functionality beyond the beacon. Shape is consistent with a dependency-confusion or reconnaissance probe: installers who resolve this name expose host metadata to the operator at that IP on every install and every import.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
